test_suite_name: Azure SQL Cross-Database Multi-Agent Evaluation Benchmark
description: Natural language evaluation suite with ground truth SQL queries across ERP (db-01-dev), WMS (db-02-dev), and TMS (db-03-dev) databases on eosr-db-server.database.windows.net.

questions.question: What is the total order value and current order status for Acme Corp's purchase order PO-ACM-2026-9921?
questions.sql_query: SELECT o.Order_ID, o.PO_Number, o.OrderStatus, o.Payment_Status, o.Total_Amount FROM dbo.tbl_SalesOrders o WHERE o.PO_Number = 'PO-ACM-2026-9921';

questions.question: How many enterprise 15-inch laptops are currently on hand in inventory, and what is their total financial asset valuation?
questions.sql_query: SELECT Item_SKU, Item_Description, Qty_On_Hand, Unit_Cost_USD, (Qty_On_Hand * Unit_Cost_USD) AS Total_Asset_Valuation_USD FROM dbo.tbl_Inventory_Master WHERE Item_SKU = 'SKU-LAPTOP-15-ENT';

questions.question: List all customers who hold Enterprise Tier 1 accounts along with their credit limits, ordered from highest to lowest credit limit.
questions.sql_query: SELECT Cust_ID, Cust_Name, Account_Type, Credit_Limit_USD, Payment_Terms FROM dbo.tbl_Customers WHERE Account_Type = 'ENTERPRISE_TIER_1' ORDER BY Credit_Limit_USD DESC;

questions.question: Which bin location, warehouse zone, and quality lot number contain active stock for Enterprise Laptops (SKU-LAPTOP-15-ENT)?
questions.sql_query: SELECT l.lot_number, l.sku_code, l.qa_status, p.bin_code, b.zone_code, b.shelf_level FROM dbo.inventory_lots l JOIN dbo.outbound_picks p ON l.lot_number = p.lot_number JOIN dbo.bin_locations b ON p.bin_code = b.bin_code WHERE l.sku_code = 'SKU-LAPTOP-15-ENT' GROUP BY l.lot_number, l.sku_code, l.qa_status, p.bin_code, b.zone_code, b.shelf_level;

questions.question: What is the physical execution status code, quantity picked, handling unit, and dock door assignment for pick task PK-8801?
questions.sql_query: SELECT p.pick_id, p.status_id, p.qty_picked, p.handling_unit_id, hu.lpn_barcode, hu.hu_type, hu.staged_dock_code, d.assigned_staging_bay FROM dbo.outbound_picks p LEFT JOIN dbo.handling_units hu ON p.handling_unit_id = hu.hu_id LEFT JOIN dbo.dock_doors d ON hu.staged_dock_code = d.dock_code WHERE p.pick_id = 'PK-8801';

questions.question: List all pallet handling units currently positioned at DOCK-04 and their tare weights.
questions.sql_query: SELECT hu_id, lpn_barcode, hu_type, tare_weight_kg, staged_dock_code FROM dbo.handling_units WHERE staged_dock_code = 'DOCK-04' ORDER BY hu_id;

questions.question: What carrier name, trailer number, and total load weight are assigned to freight load LD-2026-9041?
questions.sql_query: SELECT fl.Load_ID, fl.Trailer_Number, fl.Load_Status, fl.Total_Pallets, fl.Total_Weight_LBS, cm.Carrier_Name, cm.SCAC_Code, cm.Contact_Phone FROM dbo.Freight_Loads fl JOIN dbo.Carrier_Master cm ON fl.Carrier_ID = cm.Carrier_ID WHERE fl.Load_ID = 'LD-2026-9041';

questions.question: What is the carrier, tracking number, and current shipment status for Bill of Lading BOL-2026-10045?
questions.sql_query: SELECT Manifest_ID, BOL_Number, Carrier_Name, Tracking_Number, Waybill_Number, Shipment_Status, Dispatched_At, Estimated_Delivery FROM dbo.Carrier_Manifests WHERE BOL_Number = 'BOL-2026-10045';

questions.question: For customer Acme Corp's laptop order, what is the physical pick task ID, who picked it, and which handling unit was it packed into?

steps.description: Find the ERP Order_ID for customer Acme Corp purchasing Enterprise Laptops
steps.sql_query: SELECT o.Order_ID, o.PO_Number, c.Cust_Name, li.Item_SKU FROM dbo.tbl_SalesOrders o JOIN dbo.tbl_Customers c ON o.Cust_ID = c.Cust_ID JOIN dbo.tbl_OrderLineItems li ON o.Order_ID = li.Order_ID WHERE c.Cust_Name = 'Acme Corp' AND li.Item_SKU = 'SKU-LAPTOP-15-ENT';

steps.description: Query the WMS outbound picks using the resolved erp_order_ref 'SO-10045'
steps.sql_query: SELECT pick_id, erp_order_ref, sku_code, qty_picked, status_id, picker_badge_id, handling_unit_id, dock_loaded_at FROM dbo.outbound_picks WHERE erp_order_ref = 'SO-10045';

questions.question: What is the physical status of Acme Corp's ergonomic chairs order in the warehouse?

steps.description: Resolve the Order ID for Acme Corp's ergonomic chairs order
steps.sql_query: SELECT o.Order_ID, li.Item_SKU, o.OrderStatus FROM dbo.tbl_SalesOrders o JOIN dbo.tbl_Customers c ON o.Cust_ID = c.Cust_ID JOIN dbo.tbl_OrderLineItems li ON o.Order_ID = li.Order_ID WHERE c.Cust_Name = 'Acme Corp' AND li.Item_SKU = 'SKU-CHAIR-ERG-01';

steps.description: Query the WMS outbound picks using erp_order_ref 'SO-10046'
steps.sql_query: SELECT pick_id, erp_order_ref, status_id, qty_picked, handling_unit_id, bin_code FROM dbo.outbound_picks WHERE erp_order_ref = 'SO-10046';

expected_result.status_meaning: Picked onto picker cart (Not packed, Not loaded)

questions.question: Which carrier freight load and trailer is handling unit HU-8841-PLT loaded onto, and what is the trailer departure status?

steps.description: Verify handling unit exists and find dock staging assignment
steps.sql_query: SELECT hu_id, lpn_barcode, staged_dock_code FROM dbo.handling_units WHERE hu_id = 'HU-8841-PLT';

steps.description: Query TMS Bill of Lading and Freight Loads using Handling_Unit_Ref 'HU-8841-PLT'
steps.sql_query: SELECT bol.Handling_Unit_Ref, bol.BOL_Number, fl.Load_ID, fl.Trailer_Number, fl.Load_Status, fl.Departure_Timestamp FROM dbo.Bill_Of_Lading bol JOIN dbo.Freight_Loads fl ON bol.Load_ID = fl.Load_ID WHERE bol.Handling_Unit_Ref = 'HU-8841-PLT';

questions.question: Has customer Acme Corp's laptop order shipped, and if so, what is the carrier and tracking number?

steps.description: Find Sales Order ID and PO Number for customer 'Acme Corp' and product 'laptop'
steps.sql_query: SELECT o.Order_ID, o.PO_Number, c.Cust_Name, li.Item_SKU, o.OrderStatus FROM dbo.tbl_SalesOrders o JOIN dbo.tbl_Customers c ON o.Cust_ID = c.Cust_ID JOIN dbo.tbl_OrderLineItems li ON o.Order_ID = li.Order_ID WHERE c.Cust_Name = 'Acme Corp' AND li.Item_SKU LIKE '%LAPTOP%';

steps.description: Find the physical pick record and handling unit container for the resolved order 'SO-10045'
steps.sql_query: SELECT pick_id, erp_order_ref, status_id, handling_unit_id, dock_loaded_at FROM dbo.outbound_picks WHERE erp_order_ref = 'SO-10045';

steps.description: Find the carrier manifest and tracking number for handling unit 'HU-8841-PLT'
steps.sql_query: SELECT cm.Manifest_ID, cm.Carrier_Name, cm.Tracking_Number, cm.Waybill_Number, cm.Shipment_Status, cm.Dispatched_At, cm.Estimated_Delivery FROM dbo.Carrier_Manifests cm WHERE cm.Handling_Unit_Ref = 'HU-8841-PLT';

expected_result.conclusion: Yes, customer Acme Corp's laptop order (SO-10045) has shipped. It was packed into handling unit HU-8841-PLT, loaded at Dock 4, and dispatched via Apex Freight Express under tracking number TRK-AFX-9948201 with status IN_TRANSIT.

questions.question: What is the complete end-to-end audit trail (from financial order, to warehouse staging, to freight tracking) for customer purchase order PO-ACM-2026-9921?

steps.description: Retrieve financial order header and totals by customer PO
steps.sql_query: SELECT Order_ID, PO_Number, OrderStatus, Total_Amount, Order_Date FROM dbo.tbl_SalesOrders WHERE PO_Number = 'PO-ACM-2026-9921';

steps.description: Retrieve warehouse pick execution and handling unit
steps.sql_query: SELECT pick_id, erp_order_ref, customer_po_ref, status_id, handling_unit_id, dock_loaded_at FROM dbo.outbound_picks WHERE customer_po_ref = 'PO-ACM-2026-9921';

steps.description: Retrieve freight bill of lading and manifest using handling unit ref
steps.sql_query: SELECT cm.BOL_Number, cm.Carrier_Name, cm.Tracking_Number, cm.Gross_Weight_LBS, cm.Shipment_Status, cm.Estimated_Delivery FROM dbo.Carrier_Manifests cm JOIN dbo.Bill_Of_Lading bol ON cm.BOL_Number = bol.BOL_Number WHERE bol.Handling_Unit_Ref = 'HU-8841-PLT';

questions.question: Did Acme Corp order SO-10012 ever get picked or loaded onto a delivery truck?

steps.description: Check order status in ERP
steps.sql_query: SELECT Order_ID, Cust_ID, OrderStatus, Payment_Status, Internal_Notes FROM dbo.tbl_SalesOrders WHERE Order_ID = 'SO-10012';

steps.description: Attempt to find pick task in WMS for cancelled order
steps.sql_query: SELECT pick_id, erp_order_ref, status_id FROM dbo.outbound_picks WHERE erp_order_ref = 'SO-10012';

expected_result.conclusion: No. Order SO-10012 was cancelled and refunded in the ERP prior to fulfillment. No pick task was generated in the WMS.

questions.question: Has Globex Corporation's laptop order shipped, and which carrier handled it?

steps.description: Find Order ID for Globex Corporation purchasing laptops
steps.sql_query: SELECT o.Order_ID, c.Cust_Name, li.Item_SKU FROM dbo.tbl_SalesOrders o JOIN dbo.tbl_Customers c ON o.Cust_ID = c.Cust_ID JOIN dbo.tbl_OrderLineItems li ON o.Order_ID = li.Order_ID WHERE c.Cust_Name LIKE '%Globex%' AND li.Item_SKU = 'SKU-LAPTOP-15-ENT';

steps.description: Find handling unit for Globex order SO-10047
steps.sql_query: SELECT pick_id, erp_order_ref, handling_unit_id, status_id FROM dbo.outbound_picks WHERE erp_order_ref = 'SO-10047';

steps.description: Find carrier and tracking for Globex handling unit HU-8843-PLT
steps.sql_query: SELECT Carrier_Name, Tracking_Number, Shipment_Status FROM dbo.Carrier_Manifests WHERE Handling_Unit_Ref = 'HU-8843-PLT';

expected_result.conclusion: Yes. Globex Corporation's laptop order (SO-10047) was dispatched via Swift Global Logistics under tracking number TRK-SW-7719283 and has already been delivered.

questions.question: Is Acme Corp's branch office expedited order (PO-ACM-2026-9930) currently on a delivery truck?

steps.description: Find Order ID for PO-ACM-2026-9930
steps.sql_query: SELECT Order_ID, PO_Number, OrderStatus FROM dbo.tbl_SalesOrders WHERE PO_Number = 'PO-ACM-2026-9930';

steps.description: Check WMS status code for SO-10048
steps.sql_query: SELECT pick_id, erp_order_ref, status_id, handling_unit_id FROM dbo.outbound_picks WHERE erp_order_ref = 'SO-10048';

steps.description: Check TMS manifest status for HU-8844-PLT
steps.sql_query: SELECT Carrier_Name, Tracking_Number, Shipment_Status, Dispatched_At FROM dbo.Carrier_Manifests WHERE Handling_Unit_Ref = 'HU-8844-PLT';

expected_result.conclusion: No, it is not currently on a delivery truck. It is staged at Dock 7 (WMS status_id = 4) and marked PENDING_PICKUP in the TMS by FedEx Freight Regional, awaiting carrier trailer arrival.
